crossRefs.note: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t…

translations.web: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,
translations.bsb: Then Jesus turned to the disciples and said privately, “Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.
translations.kjv: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
translations.asv: And turning to the disciples, he said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
